paite: Judah kumpipa Hezekiah mite'n ateikhiak uh, hiaite leng Solomon paunakte ahi uh.
heading: Solomon Paunak Dangte

paite: Thil iim Pathian thupina ahi; himahleh thu zonkhiak kumpite thupina ahi.
Van sandan, huan lei thukdan, huan kumpipate lungtang zonkhiak theih ahi kei hi.
Dangka a kipan tui-ek lamang in, huan siangsakmi a ding in tui-um belsuan ahong omkhe ding.
Kumpipa ma a kipan gilou lamang in, huan alaltutphah diktatna a hihkip ahi ding hi.
Kumpipa ma ah malam sang ah om ke'n, huan mithupite omna mun ah dingh ke'n.
Hiai lam ah hong paitou in, na kiang a ahon chih uh ahoihzaw; na mitte'n amuhsa uh, lal ma a koihniam a na om sang in.
Sual ding in kinoh in kuankhe pah ke'n, atawp in bang hih ding ahia chih na thei kei kha ding.
Na inveng toh kal thu amau toh genkhawm un, huan midang thugukte pholhsuah ke'n!
Huai za in nang a hon kou kha dia, na zahlakna akiheimang kei kha ding hi.
Kituaktak a thu khat gen dangka kuang sung a dangka-eng epul theite bang ahi.
Thumangmi bil ah taihilh mipil dangka-eng bilbah leh dangka-eng hoih chỉ khi bang ahi.
Pawltak huan vukvot bang in, huchi in sawltak ginom amah sawlte a ding in ahi; apute kha ahihhalh zel hi.
Vuah pai lou meipite leh huih bang in, huchi in kuapeuh dikloutak a athilpiakte a ki-uangsak ahi hi.
Doh theih mahmahna in vaihawmpa thuzoh ahi, huan lei nem in guh ahihtan ding hi.
Khuaizu na muta hia? Nang a dia hun lel ne in; huchi lou in zaw na vah ding a, na lo kha ding hi.
Na inveng inn ah hoh vang in; huchi lou in zaw ahon chimtak in ahon mudah kha ding hi.
A-inveng siatna dia zuaugen khetbuk, namsau leh thal hiam bang ahi.
Buai hun a miginom lou muan zaw ha kisia leh khepek guh kilawi bang ahi.
Milunggim kiang a lasa tuh khovot lai a puansilh suah bang leh zu leh tangal hel bang ahi.
Na melma agil akialleh nek ding tanghou pia inla; huan adang atakleh, dawn ding tui pia in.
Alutung a mei-am sekkhawm hi ding lah na hi ngal a, huan TOUPA'N kipahman nang a hon pe ding hi.
Mal huih in vuah ahon zusak pah a; huchibang in migensiatna lei in hehmel abawl hi.
Inn tung ning a ten, insung za a kisel hat numei toh tenkhawm sang in ahoihzaw hi.
Kha dangtak a dia tui votte bang in, gam gamla a pan tanchinhoih ahi.
Migilou in midiktat alam pialsak tuh tuikhuk suknit leh tui nak hihsiat bang ahi.
Khuaizu tampi nek ahoih kei; huchi mah bang in mite ding in amau thupina zonkhiak thupina ahi kei.
Amah a lungsim thuzohna bei khopi chimsa leh bang nei lou bang ahi.
